arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Eldritch at the Tree of Whispers.

Release a {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} when damaging an enemy with your skills. {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} deals an additional {c_random}{SF_9}{/c} Shadow damage and echoes this damage to all other nearby enemies of the same type.{if:SF_2}

Damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%x|]{/c} each time damage is echoed and is guaranteed to echo at least {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} times. May strike the same target multiple times.{/if}
